headline: 🔥 A SECOND buyer came back 'interested: Yes' on 5167 Lake Crest — the read landed 7/21 6:11p, after the deal ratified, so nobody worked it. Ask for a backup offer before Friday's 9 AM inspection. Meanwhile 9 showings still owe reads (195 Lake View's Sunday has been re-asked four times), and you owe feedback on 7 homes you toured.

hotSignals.signal: 🔥 BACKUP BUYER — Kulsum B. (Keller Williams Hoover) answered 'Is your client interested in this listing? Yes' on the Mon 7/20 5:30 PM showing. Every other box blank: no price objection, no staging note, no complaint of any kind. The read arrived 6:11 PM on 7/21, hours after the contract ratified, so it was filed as leftover instead of read as live demand.
hotSignals.action: Call Kulsum and ask for a written backup offer this week. Your contract carries a 5-day inspection contingency and the physical inspection is Fri 7/24 at 9:00 AM — that is the one window where this deal can die, and a backup at or near the $899K list costs you nothing while quietly strengthening you on any repair ask. Fold the news into today's Sulman roadmap call.

hotSignals.signal: ✅ SIGNAL REALIZED — the full-price offer from buyer agent Manda L. went UNDER CONTRACT at the full $899K list ($10K earnest, no closing-cost ask, no home warranty, 5-day inspection, no home-sale contingency). Three showings in 32 hours drove it.
hotSignals.action: ⚠️ Two loose ends: the close date moved up to 8/14 is NOT agreed — the contract still says 8/19 and only the lender replied. And the cancelled Wed 4:30 showing is still on your calendar as a phantom. Kill the event, confirm Friday 9 AM with Manda yourself.
